papers.closest_delta_to_ours: This is the CLOSEST prior art to I2: a training-free, reference-free, audio-grounded N-best selector with real WER gains. Deltas: (a) it re-synthesizes via a generative TTS rather than reading frozen OMNI-NATIVE embeddings; (b) pool is single-engine Whisper beam, not frozen omni-MLLM K-pools; (c) it realizes only ~14-35% of oracle headroom, leaving exactly the rho-realization gap we target; (d) never supply-stratified, never cross-task.
papers.kill_relevance: I1: PARTIAL-THREAT (a genuine label-free N-best selector with -2.9% to -21.5% rel WER) but single-engine beam pool, not omni K-pools, and leaves most headroom unrealized. I2: STRONGEST THREAT (audio-grounded, training-free, reference-free selector; SWBD 15.02->11.93) — but uses TTS re-synthesis not frozen omni-native signals and realizes only ~14% (LS-clean) of oracle headroom, so I2 must differentiate on omni-native signal + higher rho. I3: no-threat (single ASR task, no abstention/Goodhart). I4: no-threat (single supply, no capability-supply-stratified H(c)).

families.saturation_note: The ESTIMATION branch of this family (e-WER 2018 -> e-WER2 2020 -> Fe-WER 2023 -> SIWE 2024 -> Robust-Approximation 2025) is mature and near-saturated for one narrow job: predicting the scalar WER/CER of a SINGLE system output without a reference (best OOD ~PCC 0.66-0.69, RMSE ~0.13-0.27; Robust-Approx within single-digit absolute across 40 models x 14 datasets). But essentially NONE of it does per-utterance N-best SELECTION or measures oracle-headroom realization. Only two members actually SELECT among candidates: NoRefER (text-only, and TRAINED via contrastive fine-tuning; reports ranking correlation 0.42-0.58, never WER-after-selection) and READ/Read-What-You-Hear (audio-grounded, genuinely training-free + reference-free, real WER gains -2.9% to -21.5% relative — but single-engine Whisper beam pool and realizes only ~14-35% of oracle headroom). Therefore the specific object of our study — a training-free, audio/omni-NATIVE-grounded selector over frozen omni-MLLM K-pools that REALIZES a large fraction of oracle headroom (our rho target), stratified by capability-supply c — is NOT saturated. The single most dangerous paper is READ (closest to I2), and it must be run as our headroom-realization kill test; NoRefER is the closest text-only I1 comparator. The measured gap they leave (READ realizing only ~14% of LS-clean headroom) is precisely our claimed contribution surface.
gaps: Never studies supply-STRATIFIED pools: no paper conditions headroom H(c) on capability-supply (bare-core vs +context vs +retrieval) — I4 is entirely uncovered.

Never uses omni-MLLM / omni-NATIVE K-pools: candidate supply is single-ASR-engine beam N-best (READ), commercial-engine/compression-level variants (NoRefER), or synthetic errors (SIWE) — none sample a frozen speech/omni LLM.

Most of the family is SUPERVISED scalar ESTIMATION, not training-free SELECTION: e-WER/e-WER2/Fe-WER/SIWE/Robust-Approx all train a regressor and output a scalar WER; only READ is training-free AND a selector.

No equal-BUDGET / equal-K headroom framing: none reports fraction-of-oracle-headroom-realized under a fixed K vs baselines (READ shows raw WER-after-selection but no rho vs equal-K comparators; estimators report Pearson/RMSE, not selection deltas).
ASR-WER-ONLY, single-modality metric: no cross-task selection (ST/SER/SLU/spoken-QA/audio-understanding) — SER/SLU/QA datasets are not WER-scorable, so I3's cross-task/abstaining scope is untouched.
No abstention / Goodhart-breakpoint detection: no member detects when the reference-free proxy diverges from true quality or abstains — I3 is uncovered.

Language/domain narrow: Arabic broadcast (e-WER), English read/meeting (Fe-WER/SIWE/READ), Indic reference-based (LASER); little clean overlap with our multilingual/omni eval suite beyond LibriSpeech-style ASR.
Correlation-reported not headroom-realized: estimators optimize Pearson/RMSE against true WER, a fundamentally different target than picking the best of K to eat oracle headroom.

LLM-judge branch (LASER) is reference-BASED and text-only, and Robust-Approx's proxy-reference is used for metric estimation not selection — the omni-as-reward-for-SELECTION combination we pursue is unexplored by this family.

papers.candidate_source_supply: bare-model sampling (up to N=1860 solutions uniformly sampled from ONE fixed generator; single supply level; no beam-lattice, no +retrieval-context)

families.saturation_note: MECHANISM SPACE IS HEAVILY SATURATED, SPEECH INSTANTIATION IS NOT. Every core selection mechanism this family teaches is mature in text/vision: label-free majority-vote/marginalization (self-consistency, +17.9% GSM8K, ~2022), trained-verifier best-of-N that eats voting's residual headroom (Lightman PRM 78.2 vs majority 69.6 at N=1860, ~2023), training-free LLM-as-selector generalized to free-form (USC, ~2023), and frozen cross-modal grounding as a reference-free reranker (CLIPScore tau 51.2 > CIDEr 43.9, 2021). Because the mechanisms are established, this family can NEVER supply speech-novelty and MUST be cited as mechanism-transfer/ceiling references only — it sets two bars for us: (a) I1/USC bar = 'training-free label-free selection over pools is not itself novel', (b) I2/CLIPScore bar = 'frozen cross-modal reference-free reranking is not itself novel'. Our open ground is the SPEECH/omni instantiation, audio-native grounding, supply-conditional headroom H(c), abstention/Goodhart detection, and an actually-measured realization fraction rho — none of which any paper in this family touches.",
gaps: SPEECH/AUDIO POOLS NEVER STUDIED — all four are text candidates (SC/USC/Lightman) or image-caption candidates (CLIPScore); none operates on speech/omni K-pools or ASR/ST/SER hypotheses; so none is speech-novelty evidence, only mechanism analogy.

SUPPLY-STRATIFICATION NEVER STUDIED (kills nothing on I4) — every paper uses a SINGLE candidate-generation supply (bare-model temperature sampling for SC/USC, uniform sampling from one generator for Lightman, one caption model for CLIPScore); NONE compares bare-core vs +context vs +retrieval supply, so oracle headroom H(c) as a function of capability supply c is entirely untouched.

TRAINING-FREE-vs-GOLD-VERIFIER SPLIT — the strongest headroom-eating method (Lightman PRM, 78.2 vs 69.6) REQUIRES a gold-supervised trained verifier (PRM800K, 800K human step labels), violating a weight-frozen constraint; the training-free members (SC/USC) are consensus/voting and only MATCH each other, never audio-grounded.

NO ABSTENTION / NO GOODHART-BREAKPOINT DETECTION (I3 fully open) — none detects when the selection signal has been gamed or when to abstain; Lightman's PRM can itself be over-optimized, USC/SC cannot exceed the modal answer, CLIPScore is fooled by object-matching hallucinations.

NO REALIZED-HEADROOM FRACTION IN-MODALITY FOR VISION — CLIPScore reports only correlation (tau) / pairwise accuracy, never 'fraction of oracle best-of-N headroom realized'; only Lightman gives a clean best-of-N-vs-N curve, and that is text math with a trained verifier.

EQUAL-BUDGET DISCIPLINE INCONSISTENT — only Lightman rigorously compares selectors at matched N; SC's headline is 1-vs-40, USC is context-limited small-N, CLIPScore is not a fixed-K study; no equal-K selector-vs-selector protocol against a label-free/audio-grounded baseline of the kind our C-ASR-V2 battery uses.

NO OMNI-NATIVE / SELF-MODEL AUDIO GROUNDING — the reranker is either the same LLM voting (SC/USC), a separately trained text verifier (Lightman), or a separate frozen vision-text encoder (CLIPScore); none is 'the frozen generative omni model re-reading its OWN audio input to score its own hypotheses', which is the specific object of our I2.
